description: This file defines the WorkspaceAssociation class for managing CRUD operations on workspace associations within Drupal, including methods for tracking entities, retrieving associated revisions, and initializing workspaces. It is deprecated in Drupal 11.3.0 and removed in 12.0.0, with a recommendation to use WorkspaceTracker instead.

classes.name: WorkspaceAssociation
classes.description: A class providing CRUD operations for workspace associations, implementing WorkspaceAssociationInterface and EventSubscriberInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the workspace tracker, using a service if not provided.

methods.name: trackEntity
methods.description: Tracks an entity within a workspace.

methods.name: workspaceInsert
methods.description: Placeholder for inserting a workspace (empty implementation).

methods.name: getTrackedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities tracked in a workspace.

methods.name: getTrackedEntitiesForListing
methods.description: Retrieves tracked entities for listing with pagination.

methods.name: getAssociatedRevisions
methods.description: Gets revisions associated with a workspace.

methods.name: getAssociatedInitialRevisions
methods.description: Gets initial revisions associated with a workspace.

methods.name: getEntityTrackingWorkspaceIds
methods.description: Gets workspace IDs tracking a specific entity.

methods.name: deleteAssociations
methods.description: Deletes tracked entity associations from a workspace.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an empty array, as no events are subscribed.

methods.name: getIdField
methods.description: Returns the target ID field name for an entity type.
